items.title: Raya set to have scan on injury - how much would Arsenal miss him?
items.description: Arsenal goalkeeper David Raya is set to have a scan on his shoulder after going off injured during Saturday's 2-2 draw with Newcastle.

items.title: Chelsea latest: 'He was in pain' - Alonso gives update on Caicedo injury
Hirst key for Stoke, injuries derail Millwall - Sam Parkin's EFL takeaways
items.description: After the last international break of the year, Final score pundit and former Swindon Town, Luton Town and Northampton Town striker selects his takeaways from the Championship, League One and League Two.

items.title: AC Milan monitoring Man Utd's Fernandes - Sunday's gossip
items.description: AC Milan monitoring Manchester United midfielder Bruno Fernandes, Arsenal pair yet to start talks on new deals and Trabzonspor renew interest in Tottenham forward Richarlison, plus more.

items.title: Arsenal latest: Arteta gives update on Raya injury
'We lost two points' - Arteta on 'unacceptable' Newcastle draw
items.description: Arsenal manager Mikel Arteta says his side squandered the chance to take all three points after their 2-2 draw against Newcastle United at St James' Park. The result sees the reigning Premier League champions go six points clear at the top of the table.

items.title: How 'complacent' Arsenal unravelled at Newcastle - and their key lesson
items.description: From "exceptional" to "complacent" - Arsenal's drop-off in the second half at Newcastle was extraordinary.

items.title: Nine wins in a row - Bournemouth & Evanilson continue to make history
items.description: With a ninth successive win, Bournemouth continue to make history under new manager Marco Rose.

items.title: Arsenal go six points clear after lively draw at Newcastle
items.description: Noni Madueke's second-half goal earns Arsenal a 2-2 draw against Newcastle United at St James' Park, as the reigning champions move six points clear at the top of the Premier League table.

items.title: Evanilson strikes again as Bournemouth beat Forest
items.description: Evanilson scores in his sixth consecutive Premier League game, as Bournemouth defeat Nottingham Forest 2-0 at the Vitality Stadium.

items.title: Leeds dominate Chelsea for first Stamford Bridge win since 1999
items.description: Noah Okafor scores twice to deliver Leeds United's first win at Chelsea in 27 years, in an impressive 4-1 victory at Stamford Bridge. They move up to sixth in the Premier League.

items.title: Man City drop points to Fulham despite superb Anderson volley
items.description: Elliot Anderson's fantastic volley earns Manchester City a first Premier League point in over a month as they come from behind to hold Fulham.
